correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs every \(D_2(u)\) by two independent definitions, exhaustively enumerates all maximal cliques of the 64-vertex compatibility graph, separately enumerates all four-cliques, and directly recomputes the core, dominance status, and reversal/complement orbits. It obtains maximal-clique histogram \(217,276,16\) at sizes \(2,3,4\), so the maximum is \(4\) with exactly 16 equality cases. No infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The archive-era literature explicitly separates finding \(L_2(n,t)\) from classifying optimal codes and then inequivalent basic optimal codes. The result completely resolves that natural structural follow-on for \(n=6,t=2\): it gives all 16 labeled maxima, the universal constant-word core, all standard equivalence classes, and both basic classes. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary slice or a mere recomputation of a known table entry.
